title: Associativity of Yoneda splicing of extensions
statement: Let $X$ be a ringed space and let $\mathcal A,\mathcal B,\mathcal C,\mathcal D$ be $\mathcal O_X$-modules, with Ext as in [def-sc-ext-sheaf]. Yoneda splicing of composable exact sequences, equivalently Yoneda composition of their Ext classes, is associative: for composable classes $e\in\operatorname{Ext}^i_X(\mathcal A,\mathcal B)$, $f\in\operatorname{Ext}^j_X(\mathcal B,\mathcal C)$, and $g\in\operatorname{Ext}^k_X(\mathcal C,\mathcal D)$, one has $(g\circ f)\circ e=g\circ(f\circ e)$ in $\operatorname{Ext}^{i+j+k}_X(\mathcal A,\mathcal D)$, with the usual canonical identifications of iterated sums.
